name: This Magical Girl is a B⭐tch
source:
⭐DA-DA-DA-DADA!⭐

BULLIES OF MIDDLING MIDDLE SCHOOL, YOU'RE IN FOR A SURPRISE!

It's Halloween Spirit Week and even grumpy Tabbie is ready for some fun.

But when her NEMESIS, Eden (the [u]WORST[/u] kind of eighth grade boy), 
steals her thunder, everything goes horribly wrong.

Luckily for her, a magical pixie gives her the power
to GRAB fate and [u]WHACK THE SHIT out of anyone in her way![/u]

UH OH! Watch out for Tabitha Bones!
(Mr. Teacher can already feel a headache coming...)

[From [url=https://belleinpastel.itch.io/this-magical-girl-is-a-btch]itch.io[/url]]
